auditor: Same-session separate discovery/review agent; not an external peer reviewer
scope: Initial read-only review of experimental constructor, protocols, provenance and results by a separate same-session agent. Hashes and local Git blob identities were independently recomputed. After identifying additive-wrapper defects, the root assigned this reviewer to repair those wrappers, preserve their failed versions and run a semantic replay. Frozen experimental code, inputs and original reports were not changed.

observed_results.measurement_v1_1: 3/3 same-source reproduction accepted; no fresh-evidence claim
observed_results.fresh_confirmation: 3/3 researcher-specified new nominal programs accepted, 6/6 specified geometric negatives refused
observed_results.exploratory_schema: Duplicate and missing feature identifiers were accepted by validate(); both failures remain recorded
observed_results.current_freeze: All three files listed in FRESH_FREEZE.json match their current recorded SHA-256 values
observed_results.historical_preservation: Current bytes of produce_v1_failed.py, produce_v1_1_measurement.py and produce.py match their corresponding result-record constructor hashes

meaningful_checks: Valid single-solid checks reject invalid topology and component counts for the evaluated shapes.
Analytic net volume is separate arithmetic from the solid kernel; it is valid only under the admitted disjoint-feature assumptions.
Native-reference Boolean symmetric difference checks shape agreement and is materially stronger than matching bounding box and volume alone.
Independent fresh native code uses hole/cboreHole/cskHole against the constructor's primitive cuts; shared OpenCascade remains a common-cause limitation.
Fresh point-membership probes check local hole centers, lower walls and top recesses, although they are finite samples and share the same kernel.
Geometric negative cases exercise known scope restrictions, but six cases do not characterize all malformed inputs or establish general robustness.

findings.finding: Fresh checker validates constructor hash against the protocol's embedded digest, but does not read FRESH_FREEZE.json or reject a changed protocol or checker itself.
findings.evidence: verify_confirmation.py main(): digest(produce.py) != data['constructor_sha256']; protocol/checker hashes are recorded only.
findings.implication: Current frozen bytes match, but a changed request could run and report new hashes under the same output directory unless a separate guard compares the frozen identities.
findings.status: Planned additive wrapper remediation pending at this audit snapshot.
findings.resolution: Remediated on the additive verify_study.py/reproduce.py route: immutable expected protocol/checker/constructor hashes and freeze declarations are verified. Raw frozen checker remains unchanged.

findings.finding: Fresh checker writes FAIL_FROZEN_CONFIRMATION without making that status a nonzero process exit.
findings.evidence: verify_confirmation.py final main body prints the result and returns normally regardless of result['status'].
findings.implication: A caller that trusts exit status alone can mistake failed geometric confirmation for a successful gate.
findings.status: Planned wrapper derives failure from report conditions; pending.
findings.resolution: Remediated by additive report reconstruction and nonzero failure exit. Disposable changed-protocol subprocess actually returned exit1 and statusFAIL. Raw frozen checker still should not be used as a standalone gate.

findings.finding: Missing and duplicate feature IDs are not rejected by validate().
findings.evidence: src/produce.py validate() checks coordinates and geometry but does not require unique IDs; fresh exploratory_schema_cases both have refused=false.
findings.implication: Feature table identities are not a dependable key. Missing identifiers can lead to blank CSV IDs or a later checker KeyError; duplicates are ambiguous for downstream joins.
findings.status: Open and preserved. No frozen source fix requested.

findings.finding: Original STEP roundtrip acceptance checks solid validity, count, volume and dimensions but not Boolean geometry difference or feature probes on the reimport.
findings.implication: Those checks alone do not rule out equal-volume relocation of an internal hole or other same-box geometry changes.
findings.status: Planned retrospective supplementary symmetric-difference check pending; original criterion remains accurately described.
findings.resolution: Supplemented retrospectively: all six known-case STEP reimports have Boolean symmetric difference zero, valid single solids and accepted dimensions. Original frozen criterion is unchanged; no new scientific confirmation.

findings.finding: Feature recipes preserve nominal coordinates but not all upstream parametric dependencies.
findings.evidence: Ex003 source constructs hole centers from rect(length-cbore_inset,width-cbore_inset), whereas feature_program.json stores x=+/-34,y=+/-44 explicitly.
findings.implication: Changing source length 80 to 90 with inset12 moves source x coordinates to +/-39; changing stock length alone in the new recipe leaves x at +/-34. Both are editable, but preserved original design dependencies are not demonstrated.
findings.status: Claim stopped; root confirms no parametric-edit-relation claim. Fresh cases are new supplied nominal requests.

findings.finding: Historical runner does not restrict spec['source_file'] to members of the verified source manifest, and output case IDs are used as paths without path confinement.
findings.implication: The program is suitable only for trusted frozen inputs in this study. It is not an admitted arbitrary-upload or network-facing service. No adversarial path was executed.
findings.status: Open scope boundary; no untrusted service claimed.

findings.finding: Historical runner verifies files against the manifest read at runtime, but the manifest identity and feature-program identity are only recorded, not pinned against an external expected freeze.
findings.evidence: src/produce.py reads SOURCE_MANIFEST.json and loops its files, then records source_manifest_sha256/program_sha256.
findings.implication: A simultaneous data+manifest change is internally consistent and not automatically refused without a separately anchored guard.
findings.status: Planned additive wrapper pinning public-source bytes/manifest pending.
findings.resolution: Remediated on wrapper route: expected source manifest and feature-program digests are constants and source file hashes/sizes are checked.

findings.finding: Physical units are unresolved for Ex019; the exporter tags numeric coordinates in its representation convention and does not establish source physical intent.
findings.evidence: FROZEN_PROTOCOL.md, source Ex019 and per-case source_units explicitly state unknown units; features.csv supplies no physical tolerance or material.
findings.implication: Numeric acceptance is not manufacturing acceptance. Source-unit uncertainty and absent material/tolerance/datum requirements prevent physical production approval.

findings.finding: Frozen constructor default source path is external research_inputs; packaged source copy is data/public.
findings.evidence: DEFAULT_INPUTS = ROOT.parents[1]/'research_inputs'; SAMPLE_DELIVERABLE.md default command expects repository root research_inputs.
findings.implication: A standalone extracted study needs the documented --source-dir or an additive wrapper. The frozen file should not be silently edited.
findings.resolution: Remediated by reproduce.py using packaged data/public in a new destination. Fresh-directory semantic replay completed exit0.

findings.finding: Supplementary report_status trusts summary counts and vacuous all() over empty detailed evidence.
findings.evidence: A pure-function probe with accepted_cases=3, refused_negative_cases=6 and empty cases/negative_cases returned True.
findings.implication: The standalone wrapper can accept absent detailed confirmation evidence.
findings.status: Root informed; additive preservation and correction pending.
findings.resolution: Corrected in supplementary verifier v2. Exact case/negative/check IDs, boolean types and reconstructed counts are required; the formerly accepted empty-evidence mutation is rejected. Prior verifier and failure probe are archived.

findings.finding: Supplementary STEP loop accepts the output directories that happen to exist and reads their recipes rather than binding each recipe to the frozen source program or fresh request.
findings.evidence: verify_study.py iterates results folder directories and calls producer.build on each local feature_program.json.
findings.implication: Missing case directories or jointly changed recipe+STEP content are not explicitly rejected.
findings.status: Root informed; exact expected case/directory/check sets and recipe binding requested.
findings.resolution: Corrected in supplementary verifier v2. Exact expected directory and artifact sets, per-case recipe equality, CSV content and historical artifact receipt hashes are checked before geometric comparison. Missing-case and changed-recipe probes are rejected.

source_classification.historical: Three upstream CadQuery educational code examples, manually interpreted by an assistant. They are not customer-supplied STEP parts, industrial benchmarks or autonomous STEP interpretation.
source_classification.fresh: Three hypothetical parametric requests specified by the root researcher after constructor freeze. They are new requests within a deliberately limited family; not customer demand, production observations or population-generalization evidence.
source_classification.license: Packaged CadQuery Apache-2.0 license and file identities are present. No private design was observed.
source_classification.source_comment_discrepancy: Ex003 cbore_inset comment conflicts with executable half-rectangle geometry; discrepancy is explicitly preserved.

Actual buyer acceptance, demand, receipts or profit
Recovered original design intent or manufacturing requirements
Preserved original parametric dependencies under arbitrary edits
Physical component conformity, manufacturability or machine release
Strongest-conventional-baseline superiority or measured engineering-labor reduction
Operational Alpha, retained Alpha, trained specialist or compounding
Live ENS authentication or execution authority
pending_additive_remediation: Completed for the additive wrapper route. Remaining feature-ID and parametric-dependency limitations are deliberately preserved; no deployment admission.
recommended_public_wording: A conventional nominal-geometry package was built from three public educational examples. After preserving an initial measurement failure and two documented corrections, three fresh researcher-specified requests passed the narrow geometric rubric. Six specified invalid geometric requests were refused; two feature-identifier defects remain. The work does not establish a new commercial capability or transformational flagship.
